name: mscse-thesis-advisor-not-ttt
description: DGS Handbook §10.3.2 / §10.3.8 (“Students doing a research master’s must have at least one thesis adviser who is: current tenured or tenure-track faculty at Notre Dame … If the student’s primary research director does not meet these requirements, they must have a co-adviser who meets the criteria”) and CSE §2.3 — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-dh-10-5; DGS: “Apply suggested handling”. An MSCSE thesis student whose only advisor is a research professor (not tenure-track): the advisor row reads Conditionally met and sends the case to the ADGS, instead of Met on the name alone.

detailIncludes: Your thesis advisor is not (or you are not sure they are) tenured or tenure-track CSE faculty
